name: fetch-retry
description: A resilient fetch wrapper supporting retries, delay backoff, and request timeouts.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to make HTTP requests that are resilient to temporary network failures or rate limits (returns 5xx status codes). Avoid writing raw fetch loops manually. Import using: import { fetchRetry } from './utils/fetchRetry.js';

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The destination URL for the HTTP request.

parameters.name: options.retries
parameters.description: Maximum number of retries before failing.

parameters.name: options.delay
parameters.description: Base delay for backoff in milliseconds.

parameters.name: options.timeout
parameters.description: Abort request after this timeout in milliseconds.
